title: Royal tomb theory and the lack of mummies in Khufu's and Khafre's pyramids

tellings.quote: Most Egyptologists believe the Great Pyramid was built for the pharaoh Khufu around 2500 BC as part of a massive funerary complex designed [music] to help the king ascend to the afterlife. And the Pyramid of Khafre was, of course, built for the tomb of pharaoh Khafre, Khufu's son. But, no confirmed mummies or tombs [music] of Khufu or Khafre have ever been found inside of the pyramids.

plain: Michels points out that most Egyptologists believe the Great Pyramid was built around 2500 BC for the pharaoh Khufu, to help the king rise to the afterlife, and that the Pyramid of Khafre was built as the tomb of Khufu's son Khafre. But he says "no confirmed mummies or tombs" of either king have ever been found inside the pyramids. He tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about a claimed energy grid beneath the pyramids, which suggests the pyramids might have had some purpose other than being tombs.
